messages:
amanda: Heads-up 05 opened a tiny PR to correct region codes and add a one-line data residency note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/869

leo: Thanks. Can we avoid saying "data never leaves" anywhere. Legal flagged that phrasing before. Use "processed and stored in the selected region(s) under contractual terms" instead.

tess: I updated the supported-regions table (swapped ap-south-1 -> ap-southeast-1 for SG). Also added a footnote about planned region rollouts in H2.

amanda: Nice. Can we include a tiny migration tip for Dedicated customers? Just env var and CLI example.

leo: Short snippet added to PR: `export RW_REGION=ap-southeast-1` and `redwood deploy --region ap-southeast-1`. Also a curl example to set residency header: `-H "X-Data-Residency: apac"`.

legal-bot: Reminder: replace absolute words with "we process and store" phrasing. Also add KMS link: https://internal.redwood/security/kms-integration.

tess: Done 05 replaced wording and added the KMS link. Fixed a small typo in the table header too.

amanda: LGTM from docs. If legal is happy, I'll merge and backport to the v1.2 branch.

legal-bot: Copy looks good. Approved.

amanda: Merged and added a short changelog entry: "docs: fix region codes; clarify data residency; add migration tip"

leo: Thanks folks. I'll ask Console to update tooltip text for the region selector to match the new phrasing.
